gap_text: Secret lifecycle and service identity have no native evidence. No winner manages or scopes the broker credential environment variables. OpenBao is untested, not failed.
next_check: Install a pinned OpenBao release, start `bao server -dev`, then write a test broker credential to KV. Issue a policy-scoped token, read the credential, rotate it and revoke the token, and record each exit code.

preregistration.expectation: A pinned OpenBao release (checksum verified) runs `bao server -dev` on loopback; KV write, policy-scoped token issue, read, rotation (new version), token revoke all exit 0; read with revoked token fails (non-zero).
criteria: advanced if the full lifecycle succeeds with recorded exit codes but no catalog winner is wired to manage the broker env vars (a catalog/runtime decision outside this unit)
settled only if the lifecycle succeeds and a managed/scoped delivery of broker variables is also demonstrated
not_settled if any lifecycle step fails unexpectedly
